notes.title: Demo Update 0.9.5

notes.title: Demo Update 0.9.0
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added MacOS and Linux Builds[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the UI in the Office and Camera[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the UI in the Character and Relic Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Several small issues fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Added localizations for some strings[/p][/*][*][p]Added the first achievement[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.8.12
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed some bugs and improved stability including the issue of a black screen when opening the cams[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.8.1
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added a setting for changing the amount of post processing applied to be able to increase fps on low end hardware[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.8
notes.content: [h1]Additions[/h1][list][*][p]Added a render scale setting that allows you set the resolution to a lower value to increase fps[/p][/*][*][p]Added a small cooldown to the an interactable object in the office[/p][/*][/list][h1]Changes[/h1][list][*][p]Decreased size of text in the relic selection menu[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the speed of the cellar enemy on cam D4[/p][/*][/list][h1]Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed enemies not being reset properly as they should [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the camera relic visuals not being displayed properly in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the German localization[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.7.35
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed custom night not working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual indicator for when a relic cannot be used[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cursor not updating when hovering over relic button[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased size of usage indicators[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.7.(34)
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added custom night which unlocks after completing the second night[/p][/*][*][p]Added an unlock screen which displays information on things that you unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Added the German language[/p][/*][*][p]Added a custom cursor [/p][/*][*][p]Added volume settings[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]A lot of QoL additions such as being able to skip some scenes using ESC[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced a lot of sprites and added new ones for extra polish[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the UI in the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Performance optimisations[/p][/*][*][p]Several bugs fixed[/p][/*][/list]
